segments.text:
V. 27.
A man can receive nothing—Neither he, nor I. Neither could he do this, unleſs GOD had ſent him; nor can I receive the Title of Chriſt, or any Honour comparable to that which He hath received from Heaven. They ſeem to have ſpoken with Jealouſy and Reſentment; John anſwers with ſweet Compoſure of Spirit.
